name: Minimum Teaching Set Size of Singleton–Cosingleton Classes
proof: Every target has teaching size three. To teach singleton $\{i\}$, label $i$ positive and two distinct other coordinates negative. The positive excludes the other singletons, and the two negatives exclude all cosingletons. A sample of size at most two with no positive label is consistent with at least $n-2\ge2$ singletons. A sample with a positive label must label $i$ positive; if it also labels $j$ negative, both $\{i\}$ and $[n]\setminus\{j\}$ survive. With no negative label there are again multiple realizers. Thus no such sample teaches the singleton. Complementing all labels proves the same statement for every cosingleton. Taking the minimum gives three.
references: Local definition-driven proof and exact finite replay in sync/verify_singleton_cosingleton.py. The class was already used in the survey's signed intersection-completion argument.
